incident_spec.summary: Unpredictable single insert performance due to blocking and excessive indexes.
symptoms: Single record insert performance is extremely poor in certain cases.
Blocking sessions appear in sys.dm_exec_requests but the blocking session ID does not correspond to an active session.
Blocked requests show a wait type of LCK_M_S.
incident_spec.mechanism: Blocking caused by uncommitted transactions holding locks on resources, combined with excessive indexes slowing down insert operations.

facts.evidence: The table contains approximately 8 million rows.
The table has 34 indexes in addition to a clustered index.

value.behavior: session appears sleeping but holds locks

facts.evidence: sys.dm_exec_requests shows blocking_session_id but the session is sleeping and not actively running queries.
Blocked requests show a wait type of LCK_M_S.

assumptions: The blocking is caused by uncommitted transactions holding locks on resources.
Excessive indexes contribute to slower insert performance.
unknowns: Exact query patterns or workloads causing the blocking.
Whether the blocking sessions are caused by application behavior or database configuration.

feasibility.rationale: The blocking and excessive indexes can be reproduced using synthetic data and controlled workloads. Exact reproduction of the blocking behavior may depend on simulating uncommitted transactions.

schema_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dbo.Communication (id INT IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, comm_action NVARCHAR(255), comm_channelid INT, payload NVARCHAR(MAX))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_comm_action ON dbo.Communication(comm_action)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_comm_channelid ON dbo.Communication(comm_channelid)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_payload ON dbo.Communication(payload)
generation_sql: INSERT INTO dbo.Communication (comm_action, comm_channelid, payload) SELECT CASE WHEN n % 1000 = 0 THEN N'Deskwork' ELSE N'Other' END, n % 50, CONCAT(N'Payload_', n) FROM generated_numbers WHERE n <= {row_count}

tables.name: dbo.Communication
tables.purpose: Primary table to simulate insert performance and blocking behavior.
tables.distribution_notes: Simulates a large table with skewed comm_action values and moderate cardinality for comm_channelid.

calibration_queries.sql: INSERT INTO dbo.Communication (comm_action, comm_channelid, payload) VALUES (N'Deskwork', 11, N'TestPayload')
calibration_queries.objective: Verify that the insert operation exhibits blocking behavior under specific conditions.
expected_evidence: Blocking session ID appears in sys.dm_exec_requests.
Wait type LCK_M_S is observed for the blocked request.

queries: BEGIN TRANSACTION; INSERT INTO dbo.Communication (comm_action, comm_channelid, payload) VALUES (N'Deskwork', 11, N'TestPayload'); WAITFOR DELAY '00:30:00'; COMMIT;

validation_criteria: Blocking session ID appears in sys.dm_exec_requests.
Wait type LCK_M_S is observed for blocked requests.
Insert performance is degraded under blocking conditions.
